request.summary: Create a portrait Andon status column for fictional Northstar Assembly from editable station-status rows.
request.audience: Production supervisors, line leads, and operators monitoring assembly flow from a distance.
request.primaryGoal: Group stations by production line and make active exceptions immediately identifiable without losing normal-state context.

assumptions: The 1080 by 1920 placement is the default surface and the 480 by 1920 placement is the required narrow member of the same portrait family.
Datasource row order defines line and station order so the requested table can remain limited to operational fields.
Recognized state synonyms map to Normal, Attention, or Stopped; every other non-empty state remains visible as Unknown.
When all line groups cannot fit, pages rotate and keep a line together unless that line alone exceeds one page.
All bundled names, roles, reasons, durations, and operational values are fictional.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The requested product is a tall operational column with two explicit portrait widths and one shared vertical hierarchy.

surfaces.purpose: Narrow portrait Andon column for constrained production zones.

settings.purpose: Assembly organization name in the instrument header.
Operational board label beneath the organization name.
Message shown when a bound datasource has no valid station rows.
Seconds each line-group page remains visible when pagination is required.
Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom semantic palette.
Custom line-header and station-lane surface color.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, retain the complete configured title on one line by using the full header width.
dynamicText.rationale: The organization name is the persistent board identity and must remain complete at both portrait widths.

dynamicText.fallback: Preserve the readable prefix and ellipsize only the tail after one line.
dynamicText.rationale: Line and station identity must stay aligned with the state marker and duration column.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after two complete lines while preserving the full reason in the title attribute.
dynamicText.rationale: Exception reasons carry the operational meaning and receive two lines before secondary metadata is reduced.

dynamicText.fallback: Keep the leading role or duration text and ellipsize the remaining tail.
dynamicText.rationale: Ownership and elapsed time are secondary metadata that must not displace station identity or reason.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after three complete lines inside the centered empty-state band.
dynamicText.rationale: The board must communicate an intentional no-data state instead of appearing broken.

states.expectation: Different station counts remain grouped by line with exceptions visually dominant.
The coordinated light palette preserves state hierarchy and readable contrast.
An unrecognized state remains visible with the Unknown marker shape and label.
Long names, reasons, roles, and durations remain bounded at 480 by 1920.
The board reports stable flow without manufacturing an exception headline.
Stopped stations dominate the instrument while every station remains distinguishable.
A bound empty table shows the configured quiet empty state.
Rows missing line or station are discarded while valid rows continue to render.
A large table paginates by complete line groups without overflowing the portrait surface.
The final page shows a continued line group with its remaining stations and explicit continuation context.
A datasource update changes the visible station state and reason without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: Rows group in source order and recognized state synonyms map to the four explicit visual tones.
Pages keep normal line groups intact and split only an oversized line with a continuation label.
Multi-page data advances at the configured duration and all instance-local resources release on destroy.
A pushed datasource value replaces station content in place.
Every station row states its condition in words as well as in colour, and that text stays legible against the row tint.

visualDirection.summary: A single tall industrial signal instrument with a persistent severity rail, compact line bands, and flat station lanes rather than dashboard cards.
signatureChoices: A continuous left status spine carries distinct circle, diamond, square, and neutral marker geometry through every station lane.
The header condenses site identity, live summary, and exception count into one stacked instrument readout.
Line groups are separated by full-width ruled headers and share one uninterrupted body surface.
avoid: Card grids, decorative gradients, oversized marketing typography, and color-only state communication.

visualReview.intent: The display should read from top to bottom as one production instrument, with stopped and attention states visible from across a floor while normal stations remain calm and scannable.
focus: Verify the 480-pixel column keeps complete station prefixes, reason line ink, owner metadata, and elapsed durations without horizontal spill.
Verify sparse final pages still look intentional and continuation labels are unambiguous.
Verify all-normal and all-stopped datasets change hierarchy without collapsing the shared geometry.
Verify marker geometry and state words remain distinguishable without relying on hue.
